elements.text:
async_frames ring buffer (cap=30) + async_mutex
Producer: output_video(pixbuf, pts_ns)  [protected]
   -> retain + push, drop-oldest on full (non-blocking)
Consumer: get_frame(sys_time_ns, out_pts)  [called by tick]
   -> chase-and-pick, owned +1, repeat last on empty
Virtual interface: start / stop / pause / seek / update /
   get_duration / get_width / get_height / video_render
Virtual destructor (subclass must stop threads first)

elements.text:
Demux + Decode (C with Class)
Step init: open_input -> find_stream -> find_video
 -> cfgd_video (HW, fallback to SW) -> find_audio -> cfgd_audio
API:
 read() -> WL_READ_{VIDEO,AUDIO,SKIP,EOF,ERROR}
 receive_video(out_frame, out_pts)
   -> WL_FRAME_{OK,AGAIN,EOF,ERROR}
 receive_audio(...) · drained() · flush()
 flush = avcodec_flush_buffers (for seek, NOT send NULL)
 static get_supported_hwaccels()
Video PTS 4-tier fallback: pkt_duration -> diff -> history -> tb tick
Reuses pkt / video_frame / audio_frame buffers

elements.text:
1. Media file -> WLDecoder.read()
   av_read_frame -> avcodec_send_packet
2. WLDecoder.receive_video()
   avcodec_receive_frame + PTS 4-tier extrapolation
3. WLMediaSource.pace_video(pts)
   PTS-based throttle to ~realtime (absolute baseline, no drift)
4. HW frame vframe->data[3] -> CVPixelBufferRef
   -> WLSource.output_video(pixbuf, pts)
   retain + push to ring buffer, drop-oldest on full  [decode thread]
5. [tick thread] WLSource.get_frame(sys_time)
   Chase-pick (latest frame with pts <= target), owned +1
6. WLGraphics tick_one_source collects
   -> wl_frame_output_cb(src, frame, pts, ctx)  per-source output
7. (M3 TODO) Metal composite -> encode / record / stream
